description: This file provides a Python interface to Amazon MWS APIs, including classes for various API sections such as Feeds, Reports, Orders, Products, Sellers, and Finances. It includes utility functions for request signing, MD5 calculation, and XML processing, and defines a base class for making requests to Amazon MWS with subclasses for specific API functionalities.

classes.name: MWSError
classes.description: Main exception class for Amazon MWS errors.

classes.name: DictWrapper
classes.description: Wraps XML data into a dictionary, removing namespaces.

classes.name: DataWrapper
classes.description: Validates and wraps raw data, especially for MD5 hash verification.

classes.name: MWS
classes.description: Base class for Amazon MWS API interactions, handling request signing and execution.

classes.name: Feeds
classes.description: Handles Amazon MWS Feeds API operations.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: Handles Amazon MWS Reports API operations.

methods.name: calc_md5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash of a string.

methods.name: remove_empty
methods.description: Removes keys with empty values from a dictionary.

methods.name: remove_namespace
methods.description: Removes XML namespace declarations from XML string.

methods.name: get_service_status
methods.description: Returns the status of the Amazon MWS service.

methods.name: make_request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to Amazon MWS API with signing and error handling.

methods.name: calc_signature
methods.description: Calculates the request signature for Amazon MWS.

methods.name: get_timestamp
methods.description: Returns current timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: enumerate_param
